newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land in Manila commercial/office jv.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land in Manila commercial/office jv.

text.p: Ayala Land Inc said on Monday it has entered into a joint venture agreement with a local company to develop a 2,700 square metre-lot in a highly-congested commuter area in Manila.

The property, which is to be developed jointly with Concepcion Industries Inc which owns the land, is situated along two major rail networks, the Light Railway Transit (LRT) and soon-to-be-completed EDSA Mass Railway Transit (MRT).
"The project will cater primarily to commuters in the area, LRT and EDSA MRT users, as well as to other transfer passengers taking the bus or jeeps," Ayala said in a statement.
The joint venture company will build a mutli-storey building with office and retail spaces.
Commercial spaces will be opened by September 1999, while the office areas will be completed two months thereafter.
Ayala has been tasked to manage the project.
